purpose: WP selection validation outside the original 16-input Modular rate corpus

prospective_control.name: shared-tree-wp1
prospective_control.eligible: 16-bit input and at most eight 256-pixel groups
prospective_control.selection: minimum complete-file bytes, selected wins ties
prospective_control.status: rate-only control; no runtime implementation or timing qualification

limitations: All cases are 16-bit; this does not complete general 8-bit held-out qualification.
Eight natural sources are 64x64; hdr-room is 676x449. No claim of large natural-image coverage.
HDR crops, channel projection and generated alpha share one photographic source.
Each synthetic family is related across extents; 32 files are not 32 independent natural scenes.
Eight/nine-group cases differ in shape and samples; their difference is not a pure tree-scope ablation.
PNG ancillary color/metadata is omitted and raw integers are coded under the same sRGB declaration by all encoders.
Minima over five uniform WP assignments do not qualify exhaustive independent per-stream or transform search.
